content.text: The sandbox passed setup. First `cd /workspace/edshield-evidence && git pull` so that `results/diagnosis/`, `results/llm_view/` and `results/view_comparison.md` are present (they were committed after your setup turn), and rebuild the failure tables with `make failure-tables` if they are missing. Round 0 from the setup turn is this run's baseline (`results/candidate/round_0/summary.json`; the candidate commit is in its `edshield` field). Then run the bounded improve loop described in your instructions: at most three rounds of one focused rule- or gazetteer-level change each, measured with `make eval-candidate ROUND=N RUNTIME=onnx`, with the stop conditions as written. Write `proposals/PROPOSAL.md`, `proposals/kept_rounds.json` and `proposals/round_N.patch`, copy `proposals/` and `results/candidate/round_*/` (no `raw/`) to `/mnt/session/outputs/` plus `/mnt/session/outputs/outputs.tar.gz`, and finish with the fenced `file:` blocks. Session budget: $30 at list price; the platform pauses you if it is reached, so prefer fewer, better-measured rounds over more.

input.command: cd /workspace/edshield-evidence && git stash list; git status --short | head; git pull 2>&1 | tail -5; ls results/diagnosis results/llm_view results/deterministic 2>&1; ls results/view_comparison.md
